title: Charity Care Awards and the Maternity Enrollment Deposit Base — Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care)
content:
**Coordination note between the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) and Good Faith & Price Estimates** on the enrollment deposit of a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery package.

When the patient's award covers the expected delivery date and the award's tier discount is above zero and below one hundred percent, the enrollment deposit is figured on the delivery package price reduced by that discount percentage. When the covering award carries no tier discount and has cap left, it is figured on the smaller of the delivery package price and the cap left. In every other case the award leaves the amount the enrollment deposit is figured on unchanged.

**Record terms.**
- The patient's award: the patient's approved financial assistance case, a patient holding at most one approved case at a time.
- Covers the expected delivery date (the scheduled service date on the estimate): the date falls within the award period, from the award start date through the award end date, both counted.
- Tier discount: the discount percentage of the award's Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) tier.
- Cap left: the hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case.
- Delivery package price: the Riverbend facility line plus the Riverbend professional line carrying the package's principal service code on the current version.

| Covers the date | Tier discount | Cap left | Amount the enrollment deposit is figured on |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | above 0, below 100 percent | any | delivery package price reduced by the discount |
| yes | 0 | above zero | smaller of the delivery package price and the cap left |
| yes | 0 | none | unchanged by the award |
| yes | 100 percent | any | unchanged by the award |
| no, or no approved case | any | any | unchanged by the award |

Examples (hypothetical): delivery package price 10000.00 and an 80 percent discount: figured on 2000.00. No discount and 3500.00 of cap left: figured on 3500.00.
